name: SuntionCore.SPTExtensions
teaser: Extension features for SuntionCore, primarily consisting of dependency-injected utility classes.
description:
English

SuntionCore.SPTExtensions

This module consolidates utility classes that depend on SPT-related classes. It serves as an extension to the SuntionCore module. By default, this module supports both Chinese (“ch”) and English (“en”) and utilizes the default logging path provided by SuntionCore.

To change the display language:
SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod.I18NSPTExtensions.Value.CurrentLang = "target_language"

To extend language support:
Fork my repository, refer to the content within the OnLoad function in the C# code under SuntionCore.SPTExtensions/Services to add your extensions, and then submit a Pull Request. Please avoid making extensive modifications to files, as this makes the review process difficult.

Features

ModMailService

  • Smart Message Splitting: Automatically splits long texts by newlines (SplitStringByNewlines) to prevent client overflow.
  • Async Batch Sending: Supports high-volume asynchronous dispatch (SendAllMessageAsync).
  • Economy Integration: Handles multi-currency payments, payouts, and item mailing.
  • Error Handling: Includes comprehensive exception catching with localized error messages.

ProfileAndAccountService

  • ID Mapping Cache: Maintains a bidirectional cache between Player IDs (Pmc/Scav) and Account IDs.
  • Fast Lookup: Provides GetPmcDataByPlayerId to retrieve player profiles instantly using any ID type.
  • Auto-Indexing: Implements IOnLoad to automatically build account data indices on server startup.

Infrastructure

  • Lazy Initialization: Static entry point (SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod) provides on-demand Logger and I18N instances.
  • Localization: Registered translation keys for English and Chinese (e.g., KeyInvalidMoneyId, KeyProfileNotFound).

How to Reference This Library in Your Project

>= v1.2.0

Add PackageReference By NuGet

.csproj:

<ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="SuntionCore" Version="x.x.x" />
    <PackageReference Include="SuntionCore.SPTExtensions" Version="x.x.x" />
</ItemGroup>

Old Version

  1. Create a libs folder within your mod project directory (optional).
  2. Install both this module and the SuntionCore module into SPT (this module’s releases are packaged by default for universal mod installation). Copy "YourGameFolder\SPT\user\mods\SuntionCore\SuntionCore.dll" and "YourGameFolder\SPT\user\mods\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.dll" to the libs folder mentioned above.
  3. Add the following content to your YourProjectName.csproj file: 
    <ItemGroup>
    <Reference Include="SuntionCore.dll">
        <HintPath>libs\SuntionCore.dll</HintPath>
        <Private>False</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="SuntionCore.SPTExpand.dll">
        <HintPath>libs\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.dll</HintPath>
        <Private>False</Private>
    </Reference>
</ItemGroup>

    Note: HintPath should be the relative path of the actual DLL files relative to your .csproj file.
    Private must be set to False to prevent incorrectly bundling all referenced libraries during the build output. Please refer to the documentation in my repository, as HTML tags within the .csproj file are stripped/blocked when rendered on the webpage.

  4. Your compiler will now be able to correctly reference and use the contents of this library.

Create mod dependencies using the following code:

class YourModMetadata
{
    public override Dictionary<string, Range>? ModDependencies { get; init; } = new()
    {
        { "com.suntion.suntioncore", new Range(">=1.0.0") },
        { "com.suntion.suntioncore.sptextensions", new Range(">=0.1.0") }
    };
}

Credits

Inspiration sources:

  • MassivesoftCore | Regarding the creation of SPT class libraries
  • MassivesoftWeapons | Regarding referencing SPT class libraries
  • Raid Record |
    • Fund deduction/claim processing/message sending/item sending functionalities
    • Retrieving player saves/handling conversions for sessions, profileIds, etc.
  • SPT.Server | Logic for splitting items, deducting funds, adding money, etc.
中文

SuntionCore.SPTExtensions

本模块整合了依赖 SPT 相关类的工具类，作为 SuntionCore 模块的扩展。默认情况下，本模块支持中文 (“ch”) 和英文 (“en”)，并使用 SuntionCore 提供的默认日志路径。

更改显示语言：
SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod.I18NSPTExtensions.Value.CurrentLang = "目标语言"

扩展语言支持：
Fork 我的仓库，参考 SuntionCore.SPTExtensions/Services 下 C# 代码中 OnLoad 函数的内容来添加您的扩展，然后提交 Pull Request。请避免对文件进行大量修改，这会增加审核难度。

功能特性

ModMailService

  • 智能消息分割：自动按换行符分割长文本 (SplitStringByNewlines)，防止客户端溢出。
  • 异步批量发送：支持高容量异步分发 (SendAllMessageAsync)。
  • 经济系统集成：处理多货币支付、支出和物品邮寄。
  • 错误处理：包含全面的异常捕获，并返回本地化的错误信息。

ProfileAndAccountService

  • ID 映射缓存：维护玩家 ID（Pmc/Scav）与账户 ID 之间的双向缓存。
  • 快速查找：提供 GetPmcDataByPlayerId 方法，可使用任何 ID 类型即时检索玩家档案。
  • 自动索引：实现 IOnLoad 接口，在服务器启动时自动构建账户数据索引。

基础设施

  • 懒加载初始化：静态入口点 (SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod) 按需提供 Logger 和 I18N 实例。
  • 本地化：注册了英文和中文的翻译键（例如 KeyInvalidMoneyId、KeyProfileNotFound）。

如何在您的项目中引用此库

>= v1.2.0

使用NuGet添加包引用:

.csproj:

<ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="SuntionCore" Version="x.x.x" />
    <PackageReference Include="SuntionCore.SPTExtensions" Version="x.x.x" />
</ItemGroup>

旧版本

  1. 在您的模组项目目录中创建一个 libs 文件夹（可选）。
  2. 将此模块和 SuntionCore 模块都安装到 SPT 中（本模块的发布包默认为通用模组安装格式）。将 "您的游戏文件夹\SPT\user\mods\SuntionCore\SuntionCore.dll" 和 "您的游戏文件夹\SPT\user\mods\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.dll" 复制到上述的 libs 文件夹。
  3. 在您的 YourProjectName.csproj 文件中添加以下内容： 
    <ItemGroup>
    <Reference Include="SuntionCore.dll">
        <HintPath>libs\SuntionCore.dll</HintPath>
        <Private>False</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="SuntionCore.SPTExpand.dll">
        <HintPath>libs\SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.dll</HintPath>
        <Private>False</Private>
    </Reference>
</ItemGroup>

    注意：HintPath 应是相对于您的 .csproj 文件的实际 DLL 文件路径。
    Private 必须设置为 False，以防止在构建输出时错误地打包所有引用的库。 请参考我仓库中的文档，因为在网页上渲染时，.csproj 文件中的 HTML 标签会被剥离/屏蔽。

  4. 您的编译器现在可以正确引用并使用此库的内容。

使用以下代码创建模组依赖：

class YourModMetadata
{
    public override Dictionary<string, Range>? ModDependencies { get; init; } = new()
    {
        { "com.suntion.suntioncore", new Range(">=1.0.0") },
        { "com.suntion.suntioncore.sptextensions", new Range(">=0.1.0") }
    };
}

致谢

灵感来源：

  • MassivesoftCore | 关于 SPT 类库的创建
  • MassivesoftWeapons | 关于引用 SPT 类库
  • Raid Record |
    • 资金扣除/领取处理/消息发送/物品发送功能
    • 获取玩家存档/处理 session、profileId 等的转换
  • SPT.Server | 物品拆分、扣除资金、添加资金等逻辑

versions.description:
English

Version 1.0.0 Release Notes

Bug Fix: Language Pack Loading Issue Resolved

This release addresses a critical issue where language packs failed to load due to service initialization timing conflicts. The module has been upgraded to stable version 1.0.0.

Core Fix: Refactored Service Initialization Flow

  • Double-Checked Locking Pattern: Added a private Initialize() method with double-checked locking (based on an initialized flag) to ensure I18N registration logic executes only once, eliminating race conditions.

  • Defensive Initialization: Moved initialization logic from the OnLoad lifecycle hook to the business layer. Methods including Payment, SendMoney, SendItems, and UpdateAccountData now explicitly call Initialize() at their entry points, preventing “language pack not loaded” exceptions that previously occurred when external calls were made before module loading completed.

  • Execution Order Correction: Fixed the execution sequence in ProfileAndAccountService.UpdateAccountData to ensure account data warm-up completes before any logging operations begin.

Stable Release: Version 1.0.0

This upgrade marks the core extension module’s transition out of preview state:

  • Version incremented from 0.1.0 to 1.0.0 in both SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod.cs and SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.csproj
  • No breaking API changes - All existing public interfaces remain fully compatible
  • The module is now considered production-ready for all SPTarkov server modding projects
中文

版本 1.0.0 更新日志

问题修复：解决因服务初始化时序导致的语言包加载失败问题

本次更新解决了一个关键问题：由于服务初始化时序冲突，导致语言包无法正常加载。该模块现已升级至稳定版本 1.0.0。

核心修复：重构服务初始化流程

  • 双重检查锁定模式：新增了基于 initialized 标志的私有 Initialize() 方法，采用双重检查锁定模式，确保 I18N 注册逻辑仅执行一次，消除了竞态条件。

  • 防御性初始化：将初始化逻辑从 OnLoad 生命周期钩子移至业务层。Payment、SendMoney、SendItems 和 UpdateAccountData 等方法现在在其入口点显式调用 Initialize()，防止了在模块加载完成前因外部调用而导致的“语言包未加载“异常。

  • 执行顺序修正：修复了 ProfileAndAccountService.UpdateAccountData 中的执行顺序，确保账户数据预热在任何日志记录操作开始前完成。

稳定版本发布：1.0.0

此次升级标志着核心扩展模块正式退出预览状态：

  • 版本号在 SuntionCoreSPTExtensionsMod.cs 和 SuntionCore.SPTExtensions.csproj 中从 0.1.0 递增至 1.0.0
  • 无破坏性 API 变更 - 所有现有公共接口保持完全兼容
  • 该模块现已被视为生产就绪，适用于所有 SPTarkov 服务端模组开发项目

versions.description:
English

Version 1.1.0 Release Notes

Chore: Core Library Update

Observability Improvements: Enhanced Log Tracking and Exception Context Information

This release focuses on improving the robustness and debuggability of the core library, particularly in edge cases related to object disposal and missing localization data. No public API changes have been introduced.

  • Refactored ModLogger.LogMessage Logic

    • Improved error handling when the logger instance has been disposed (_disposed state).
    • Instead of failing silently, the system now outputs red-highlighted error logs directly via Console.WriteLine.
    • These diagnostic messages fully capture the context of the failure, including:
      • The affected stream type (LogWriterStream).
      • The original log message that was attempted.
      • The full exception stack trace (StackTrace).
    • This ensures that critical post-disposal logging attempts are always visible and traceable.

  • Refined I18N Exception Prompts

    • Enhanced the NotLoadLanguageException to provide clearer, more actionable error messages.
    • The exception now dynamically injects relevant context to distinguish between two common failure scenarios:
      1. Setting the current language: The error message now includes the CurrentLang that was being set when the failure occurred.
      2. Retrieving translation keys: The error message now specifies the missing key that the system attempted to translate.
    • This improvement significantly increases troubleshooting efficiency by immediately identifying the root cause of translation failures.
中文

版本 1.1.0 更新日志

项目配置：核心库更新

可观测性改进：增强对象释放后的日志追踪与异常上下文信息

本次更新专注于提高核心库在边缘情况下的鲁棒性和可调试性，特别是涉及对象已释放或本地化数据丢失的场景。本次更新未引入任何公共 API 变更。

  • 重构 ModLogger.LogMessage 逻辑

    • 改进了当日志记录器实例已被释放（_disposed 状态）时的错误处理。
    • 系统不再静默失败，而是直接通过 Console.WriteLine 输出红色高亮显示的错误日志。
    • 这些诊断消息完整地捕获了失败时的上下文信息，包括：
      • 受影响的流类型（LogWriterStream）。
      • 尝试记录的原始日志消息。
      • 完整的异常堆栈跟踪（StackTrace）。
    • 此举确保了在对象释放后关键的日志记录尝试始终可见且可追溯。

  • 完善 I18N 异常提示

    • 增强了 NotLoadLanguageException，以提供更清晰、更具操作性的错误消息。
    • 该异常现在会动态注入相关的上下文信息，以区分两种常见的失败场景：
      1. 设置当前语言： 错误消息现在会包含导致失败时正在设置的 CurrentLang（当前语言）。
      2. 检索翻译键： 错误消息现在会指定系统尝试翻译时缺失的 key（键名）。
    • 此项改进通过立即识别翻译失败的根本原因，显著提高了故障排查效率。

English

Core Features Ready

Officially released core functionalities including Magnitude Formatting (new) , Internationalization (i18n), File Utilities, and the Logging System.

Regarding API Changes

Only APIs related to Magnitude Formatting (MagnitudeFormatter) have been added. There are no changes to the usage or signatures of existing public APIs.

Test Infrastructure: Built Complete Automated Testing Environment

  • Configuration Optimization: Simplified the test project to a single target (net9.0) and added an MSBuild target to automatically copy TestFiles resources to the output directory.
  • Standardization Control: Created .gitattributes to enforce binary storage mode for binary files (*.dat, *.dll), preventing encoding corruption.
  • Architecture Refactoring: Introduced a TestData constant class for unified path management and moved MagnitudeFormatterTest to a dedicated namespace directory.
  • Internal Exposure: Used [InternalsVisibleTo] to expose internal members to the test assembly and added the IsStreamReady method for assertions.

Test Coverage: Executed Full-Module Integration and Stress Testing

  • FileSizeUtil: Verified consistency between static methods and the .ToFileSize() string extension.
  • I18N: Covered the full workflow including language loading, chained translation (::), parameter replacement ({{}}), dynamic switching, and data extension.
  • ModLogger: Executed stress tests with 500 random loads, simulating multi-instance, multi-level log writing, and exception stack tracing.

Documentation: Added Reference Guide and API Manual

  • Reference Tutorial: Added a “How to Reference This Library” section to both Chinese and English READMEs, detailing DLL copying and .csproj configuration (Private=False).
  • API Manual: Created API_ZH.md and API_EN.md containing definitions for all public interfaces; migrated detailed tables from the README to these files.
  • Usage Guidelines: Explicitly directed users to refer to the SuntionCore.Tests project for concrete code examples.
  • Acknowledgments Update: Added links and functional descriptions for the official SuntionCore mod.
中文

核心功能就绪

正式发布核心功能，包括全新的量级格式化、国际化 (i18n)、文件工具和日志系统。

关于 API 变更

仅新增了与量级格式化 (MagnitudeFormatter) 相关的 API。现有公共 API 的用法和签名均未改变。

测试基础设施：构建完整的自动化测试环境

  • 配置优化：将测试项目简化为单一目标框架 (net9.0)，并添加 MSBuild 目标以自动将 TestFiles 资源复制到输出目录。
  • 标准化控制：创建 .gitattributes 文件，强制二进制文件（*.dat, *.dll）以 binary 模式存储，防止编码损坏。
  • 架构重构：引入 TestData 常量类以统一管理路径，并将 MagnitudeFormatterTest 移至专用的命名空间目录。
  • 内部成员暴露：使用 [InternalsVisibleTo] 将内部成员暴露给测试程序集，并添加了 IsStreamReady 方法用于断言。

测试覆盖：执行全模块集成与压力测试

  • FileSizeUtil：验证了静态方法与 .ToFileSize() 字符串扩展之间的一致性。
  • I18N：覆盖了完整工作流程，包括语言加载、链式翻译 (::)、参数替换 ({{}})、动态切换和数据扩展。
  • ModLogger：执行了 500 次随机负载的压力测试，模拟了多实例、多级别日志写入和异常堆栈跟踪。

文档：新增参考指南与 API 手册

  • 引用教程：在中文和英文 README 中均新增了“如何引用此库”部分，详细说明了 DLL 复制和 .csproj 配置 (Private=False)。
  • API 手册：创建了 API_ZH.md 和 API_EN.md，包含所有公共接口的定义；并将 README 中的详细表格迁移至这些文件。
  • 使用指南：明确引导用户参考 SuntionCore.Tests 项目以获取具体的代码示例。
  • 致谢更新：添加了官方 SuntionCore 模组的链接和功能描述。

English

New Features

  • Hash Utility Class (HashUtil)

    • Added a universal hash calculation service supporting multiple algorithms: SHA1, SHA256, MD5, SHA384, SHA512 (default is SHA256)
    • Provides simple static methods: Hash(string text, HashAlgo hashAlgo) and Hash(byte[] data, HashAlgo hashAlgo)
    • Security Notice: Clearly distinguishes between recommended algorithms (SHA-2 series) and legacy algorithms (SHA1, MD5) with their applicable scenarios

  • Documentation Improvements

    • Updated Chinese and English README and API documentation, added HashUtil usage instructions

Optimizations and Adjustments

  • Centralized Module Constants Management
    • Centralized module name and logger instance management for improved code maintainability
  • Logging System Optimization
    • Simplified log access method, unified usage of SuntionCoreMod.Logger

Version Information

  • Module version updated to 1.2.0
  • Compatibility: No breaking changes, existing features remain unaffected

Developer Notes

  • When using the hash utility, please note: SHA1 and MD5 are only suitable for non-security-sensitive scenarios (such as file verification), it is recommended to use SHA256 and above algorithms
中文

新增功能

  • 哈希工具类 (HashUtil)

    • 新增通用哈希计算服务，支持 SHA1、SHA256、MD5、SHA384、SHA512 多种算法（默认 SHA256）
    • 提供简单易用的静态方法：Hash(string text, HashAlgo hashAlgo) 和 Hash(byte[] data, HashAlgo hashAlgo)
    • 安全提示：明确区分推荐算法（SHA-2 系列）与遗留算法（SHA1、MD5）的适用场景

  • 文档完善

    • 更新中英文 README 和 API 文档，新增 HashUtil 使用说明

优化与调整

  • 模组常量统一管理
    • 将模组名称和日志实例集中管理，提升代码可维护性
  • 日志系统优化
    • 简化日志获取方式，统一使用 SuntionCoreMod.Logger

版本信息

  • 模组版本号更新至 1.2.0
  • 兼容性：无破坏性变更，现有功能不受影响

开发者注意事项

  • 使用哈希工具时请注意：SHA1 和 MD5 仅适用于非安全敏感场景（如文件校验），推荐使用 SHA256 及以上算法

      1. 设置当前语言： 错误消息现在会包含导致失败时正在设置的 CurrentLang（当前语言）。
      2. 检索翻译键： 错误消息现在会指定系统尝试翻译时缺失的 key（键名）。
    • 此项改进通过立即识别翻译失败的根本原因，显著提高了故障排查效率。
